articles.summary: New York Knicks Captain 2026 Finals MVP Jalen Brunson Presented Banner To Styles During Final Residency Show At The World’s Most Famous Arena MEDIA DOWNLOADS: APPROVED PHOTOS + VIDEOS (FREE FOR USE) HERE Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (NYSE: MSGE ) (“MSG Entertainment”) celebrated the final show of Harry Styles’ sold-out 30-night “Together, Together” residency at MSG tonight by raising a banner to The Garden’s rafters and unveiling a new “Defining Moments” exhibit at the arena. During tonight’s final show of the unprecedented 30-night run, and less than two weeks after their own banner was raised to The Garden’s rafters, New York Knicks Captain and 2026 Finals MVP Jalen Brunson presented the commemorative banner to Styles. Additionally, The Garden unveiled a new “Defining Moments” exhibit on the venue’s sixth-floor concourse, featuring memorabilia from Styles’ run, that is now on display for all fans attending events at MSG.
